changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A person has an authorization generation on their account, which only a narrowing of their AI choice raises (KR-10, ADR 0134 decision 1). Every account starts at generation 0. A narrowing is a change to NO_AI, from CLOUD to IN_HOUSE_ONLY, or a cleared choice, which a workspace that requires a choice refuses. The trigger is installed with the column, whoever writes the choice.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A stamp also holds the generation of each person whose authority the work depends on, such as a review's developers or a turn's owner, under "accounts". The checks are added without validation, so their row scan runs outside the exclusive schema lock.
changeSet.sql: CREATE FUNCTION public.authorization_stamp_valid(stamp jsonb) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$ SELECT jsonb_typeof(stamp) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(stamp -> 'workspace') = 'number' AND (stamp ->> 'workspace') ~ '^[0-9]{1,19}$' AND (stamp ->> 'workspace')::numeric <= 9223372036854775807 AND (NOT (stamp ? 'accounts') OR (jsonb_typeof(stamp -> 'accounts') = 'object' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_each(stamp -> 'accounts') AS person(account, generation) WHERE person.account !~ '^[0-9]{1,19}$' OR jsonb_typeof(person.generation) <> 'number' OR (person.generation #>> '{}') !~ '^[0-9]{1,19}$' OR (person.generation #>> '{}')::numeric > 9223372036854775807))) $$; ALTER TABLE agent_run DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_authorization_stamp; ALTER TABLE agent_run ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_authorization_stamp CHECK (public.authorization_stamp_valid(authorization_stamp) IS TRUE) NOT VALID; ALTER TABLE agent_action DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_authorization_stamp; ALTER TABLE agent_action ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_authorization_stamp CHECK (public.authorization_stamp_valid(authorization_stamp) IS TRUE) NOT VALID;

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Validate the stamp checks while ordinary row writes can continue.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_run VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_agent_run_authorization_stamp; ALTER TABLE agent_action VALIDATE CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_authorization_stamp;
